behavior: Triangle models use validated runtime viewport dimensions and bounded vertex capacity. Padding is removed before raster scheduling and coverage budgets.
Triangle pipeline retention is bounded to 24 complete independent entries. No compiled-model sharing or CPU shader fallback is introduced.

One executor is checked across 31x29, 1x1, 64x17 and back to 31x29 targets, with full and empty scissors and an independent pixel oracle. Invalid finite/infinite dimensions and invalid vertex counts are rejected.
All four captured v113 failures produce complete output exactly matching the previously verified CPU and NPU output.
Cache policy is a resource-retention experiment; desktop stability, usable interaction and Tahoma performance remain unverified.
